meanings.en: the quality of being the same everywhere or for everyone
meanings.exampleEn: The uniformity of the houses made the street look monotonous.

meanings.en: more than two but not very many
meanings.exampleEn: I have visited Italy several times.

meanings.en: extremely large in size or degree
meanings.exampleEn: The project required an immense amount of effort.

meanings.en: containing no meat
meanings.exampleEn: They offer a meat-free option on every menu.
meanings.exampleTr: Her menüde etsiz bir seçenek sunuyorlar.

meanings.en: the act of transporting something, or a vehicle
meanings.exampleEn: The bus served as their main conveyance to work.
meanings.exampleTr: Otobüs, işe gitmek için ana taşıma araçlarıydı.

meanings.en: a doctor who treats animals
meanings.exampleEn: The veterinarian gave our dog a vaccination.

meanings.en: a person ranking immediately below the president
meanings.exampleEn: The deputy president chaired the meeting in her absence.
meanings.exampleTr: Başkan yardımcısı, onun yokluğunda toplantıya başkanlık etti.

meanings.en: a person who suffers from an illness or hardship
meanings.exampleEn: Every sufferer of the disease deserves proper care.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalığın her hastası uygun bakımı hak eder.

meanings.en: a person killed or injured in an accident or war
meanings.exampleEn: The earthquake caused thousands of casualties.

meanings.en: cruel and violent behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: The film depicts the brutality of war.

meanings.en: in a violent or intense way
meanings.exampleEn: She fiercely defended her opinion.

meanings.en: made to look or behave like something real
meanings.exampleEn: Pilots train in a simulated cockpit.
meanings.exampleTr: Pilotlar benzetimli bir kokpitte eğitim alır.

meanings.en: relating to light or the sense of sight
meanings.exampleEn: The microscope uses an optical lens.

meanings.en: the quality of being loud
meanings.exampleEn: The loudness of the music hurt my ears.

meanings.en: a vehicle with wheels used for carrying goods
meanings.exampleEn: He pushed the cart through the supermarket.

meanings.en: in an unfriendly or unemotional way
meanings.exampleEn: She greeted him coldly and walked away.
meanings.exampleTr: Onu soğuk bir şekilde selamladı ve uzaklaştı.

meanings.en: a bowl for washing your hands and face
meanings.exampleEn: He filled the washbasin with warm water.

meanings.en: a small piece or amount of something
meanings.exampleEn: She wrote the number on a scrap of paper.

meanings.en: spending or costing much more than is necessary
meanings.exampleEn: They threw an extravagant party for their anniversary.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıldönümleri için savurgan bir parti verdiler.

meanings.en: careful about spending money
meanings.exampleEn: Being thrifty helped her save for a house.
meanings.exampleTr: Tutumlu olması bir ev için para biriktirmesine yardımcı oldu.

meanings.en: dirty and untidy in appearance
meanings.exampleEn: He wore a scruffy old coat to the interview.
meanings.exampleTr: Mülakata pasaklı eski bir palto giydi.

meanings.en: an area of low, wet, soft land
meanings.exampleEn: Birds nest in the marsh near the river.
meanings.exampleTr: Kuşlar nehrin yakınındaki bataklıkta yuva yapar.

meanings.en: an area of very wet land with thick vegetation
meanings.exampleEn: Crocodiles live in the swamp.

meanings.en: all the animals living in a particular area
meanings.exampleEn: The island's fauna includes many rare birds.
meanings.exampleTr: Adanın faunası birçok nadir kuş içerir.

meanings.en: in a wild or extreme way
meanings.exampleEn: They are madly in love with each other.

meanings.en: the state of being prepared for something
meanings.exampleEn: The troops were in a state of readiness.

meanings.en: (of a plant) to become limp and droop
meanings.exampleEn: The flowers began to wilt in the heat.

meanings.en: to become dry, wrinkled, and smaller
meanings.exampleEn: The grapes shrivel into raisins in the sun.
meanings.exampleTr: Üzümler güneşte buruşup kuru üzüme dönüşür.

meanings.en: to grow or develop in a healthy, vigorous way
meanings.exampleEn: The business began to flourish after the move.

meanings.en: a person who uses magic powers
meanings.exampleEn: In the story, a sorcerer casts a powerful spell.
meanings.exampleTr: Hikayede bir büyücü güçlü bir büyü yapar.

meanings.en: a wonderful or astonishing thing
meanings.exampleEn: The bridge is a marvel of modern engineering.

meanings.en: worn at the edges so that threads come loose
meanings.exampleEn: The collar of his shirt was badly frayed.
meanings.exampleTr: Gömleğinin yakası kötü bir şekilde yıpranmıştı.

meanings.en: worthy of being treated in a particular way
meanings.exampleEn: The charity supports deserving students.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayır kurumu hak eden öğrencileri destekler.

meanings.en: not deserving respect, attention, or effort
meanings.exampleEn: He felt unworthy of such an honour.
meanings.exampleTr: Böyle bir onura layık olmadığını hissetti.

meanings.en: the materials used to wrap or protect goods
meanings.exampleEn: The product comes in recyclable packaging.

meanings.en: expressed in speech rather than writing
meanings.exampleEn: She is fluent in spoken French.

meanings.en: abandoned or deserted
meanings.exampleEn: They found shelter in a forsaken cabin.
meanings.exampleTr: Terk edilmiş bir kulübede sığınak buldular.

meanings.en: in a way that is not typical or usual
meanings.exampleEn: He was atypically quiet during the meeting.

meanings.en: to officially cancel a law
meanings.exampleEn: Parliament voted to repeal the old tax law.
meanings.exampleTr: Parlamento eski vergi yasasını yürürlükten kaldırmak için oy kullandı.

meanings.en: a person who does not attend an event
meanings.exampleEn: Nonattendees will receive the slides by email.
meanings.exampleTr: Katılmayan kişiler slaytları e-posta ile alacak.

meanings.en: a student who stays away from school without permission
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher reported the truant to the principal.

meanings.en: a person who attends an event
meanings.exampleEn: Each attendee received a name badge.
meanings.exampleTr: Her katılımcı bir isim kartı aldı.

meanings.en: absurd or ridiculous
meanings.exampleEn: The idea sounded completely ludicrous to me.

meanings.en: cruel or unfair treatment
meanings.exampleEn: The animals showed signs of mistreatment.

meanings.en: the wrong or improper use of something
meanings.exampleEn: The misuse of antibiotics is a serious problem.
meanings.exampleTr: Antibiyotiklerin kötüye kullanımı ciddi bir sorundur.

meanings.en: the quality of being able to be reached or contacted
meanings.exampleEn: The app improves the reachability of remote villages.

meanings.en: the state of being impossible to reach or obtain
meanings.exampleEn: The inaccessibility of the region delayed rescue efforts.

meanings.en: temporary accommodation
meanings.exampleEn: They found cheap lodging near the station.

meanings.en: buildings where people live; accommodation
meanings.exampleEn: The city needs more affordable housing.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehrin daha fazla uygun fiyatlı konuta ihtiyacı var.

meanings.en: in a way that matches or relates to something
meanings.exampleEn: Demand rose, and prices increased correspondingly.
meanings.exampleTr: Talep arttı ve fiyatlar buna karşılık olarak yükseldi.

meanings.en: to gather a large amount of something over time
meanings.exampleEn: He managed to amass a fortune in ten years.
meanings.exampleTr: On yılda bir servet biriktirmeyi başardı.

meanings.en: the act of officially clearing someone of blame
meanings.exampleEn: The new evidence led to his exoneration.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni kanıt onun aklanmasına yol açtı.

meanings.en: a chemical substance that neutralizes acids
meanings.exampleEn: Soap is made by reacting fat with an alkali.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabun, yağın bir alkali ile reaksiyona girmesiyle yapılır.

meanings.en: in a lively and active way
meanings.exampleEn: She worked energetically all morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün sabah enerjik bir şekilde çalıştı.

meanings.en: without active response or resistance
meanings.exampleEn: He passively accepted the decision.
meanings.exampleTr: Kararı pasif bir şekilde kabul etti.

meanings.en: in a way that involves little or no activity
meanings.exampleEn: They spent the weekend inactively at home.

meanings.en: based on a possible situation rather than a real one
meanings.exampleEn: Let's consider a hypothetical example.

meanings.en: lasting for a long time; continually recurring
meanings.exampleEn: She suffers from chronic back pain.

meanings.en: a person who mistreats or misuses someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: The clinic helps drug abusers recover.
meanings.exampleTr: Klinik, uyuşturucu istismarcılarının iyileşmesine yardımcı olur.

meanings.en: a drug addict; an enthusiast (informal)
meanings.exampleEn: He is a complete fitness junkie.

meanings.en: addicted to or very fond of something
meanings.exampleEn: After one episode, I was hooked on the series.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir bölümden sonra diziye bağımlı oldum.

meanings.en: not addicted to something
meanings.exampleEn: He remained unaddicted despite the pressure.

meanings.en: in a way that is acceptable or good enough
meanings.exampleEn: The issue was resolved satisfactorily.

meanings.en: in a way that is not enough or not good enough
meanings.exampleEn: The room was inadequately heated.

meanings.en: relating to the work of a manager
meanings.exampleEn: She has strong managerial skills.

meanings.en: relating to the planning or structure of an organization
meanings.exampleEn: The merger required major organizational change.

meanings.en: deserving praise
meanings.exampleEn: Her efforts to help were highly commendable.
meanings.exampleTr: Yardım etme çabaları son derece takdire değerdi.

meanings.en: deserving approval and admiration
meanings.exampleEn: His honesty is truly praiseworthy.

meanings.en: deserving strong condemnation; very bad
meanings.exampleEn: The prisoners lived in deplorable conditions.

meanings.en: deserving contempt; thoroughly despicable
meanings.exampleEn: Lying to a friend is a contemptible act.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir arkadaşa yalan söylemek aşağılık bir davranıştır.
